_comment: Filled in from the interview (references/interview.md). Every field left null or empty becomes a visible [[ASK: ...]] marker instead of a guess. role: 'project' (one client or product) or 'master' (a clean starting point you copy per project). confidential_terms are committed with the harness; confidential_terms_local (other clients' names, your rates) stay on this machine only. autonomy: propose | per-item | act-and-report. parallel_work: set true/false to override whether the reconciler agent is included.

roles.lead: Owns scope, runs the first review gate, chases client follow-ups.
roles.researcher: Runs data collection and synthesis; owns insights.
roles.designer: Owns flows, screens, prototypes and the design system.

stages.name: Brief intake
stages.done_when: Lead confirms classification, scope and timeline back to the requester.

stages.name: Discovery research
stages.done_when: Every insight cites a data-collection source.

stages.name: Mental model + IA
stages.done_when: Sitemap and intent paths approved at the lead gate.

stages.name: Delivery + handoff
stages.done_when: Ship row written with the approval round it shipped from.

known_failures: Client feedback from round 1 arrived while we were on round 3 and got lost.
Juniors invented new spacing values instead of using the scale.
